newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Surgutneftegaz gets loan for new oil port.
newsitem.headline: Russian Surgutneftegaz gets loan for new oil port.

text.p: Russia's third largest bank, Uneximbank, said on Tuesday it would offer oil company Surgutneftegaz an $80 million credit to help build an export outlet on the Finnish Gulf.

The new port, based at Battery Bay, 60 km (40 miles) from St Petersburg, will handle 15 million tonnes of oil products a year when completed by 2000 and widen Russia's export capacity to Western markets.

The total cost of the project, for which a foundation stone was laid last week, is $200 million. Surgutneftegaz, Russia's third-largest crude oil producer, will spend another $100 million to build a 336 km (200 mile) pipeline from its Kirishi oil refinery to the facility.
